<issue_description>
Heap-buffer-overflow in parser.c (xmlParseCommentComplex). While parsing XML comments the code can write past the end of a heap-allocated comment buffer (a 1-byte out-of-bounds write when accumulating/terminating comment text). This heap corruption, triggered via xmlParseComment/xmlParseMisc, can cause crashes or potentially be exploited for arbitrary code execution when processing crafted comments.
